cards.text: The average of 48 was the lowest of the season so far, dragged down by the most-owned names around the captain.

cards.badge: Scored in 4 gameweeks in a row
cards.text: Haaland found the net again but took no bonus, a modest return for the armband. Vice-captain favourite B.Fernandes managed just 2 points.

cards.title: Joint top scorers in an eight-goal thriller
cards.text: Man City beat Sunderland 5-3. Brobbey hit a hat-trick in defeat after 4 blanks in a row, while Semenyo posted his best score this season.

cards.title: Brighton run riot against Arsenal
cards.text: Groß (14 points) scored and assisted again, and Kostoulas (10 points) did the same for his 1.0% of owners.
The bandwagon on Gibbs-White fizzled, but those who bought Groß were richly rewarded.
